# CSV Shield
> A free CSV repair tool that runs in the browser. Files are processed locally and not uploaded.

## What it does
- Repairs unescaped double quotes so rows stop shifting into the wrong columns (RFC 4180 quoting). Valid files are left unchanged.
- Fixes mojibake: UTF-8 text that was read as Windows-1252 (CafÃ© -> Café, â€™ -> ’). Text that does not decode as valid UTF-8 is left alone.
- Detects comma, semicolon, tab and pipe delimiters.
- Optional: trim spaces, drop blank rows, pad short rows, remove exact duplicate rows.
- Optional masking of emails, phone-formatted numbers and card numbers (last four digits kept). Pattern based; it does not detect names or addresses.
- Exports CSV (optional UTF-8 BOM for Excel), JSON, Markdown and SQL INSERT statements.

## Limits
- Quote repair is a heuristic; ambiguous cells should be checked.
- Large files are processed in one go in the browser and can be slow.
- Not a compliance certification. Not uploading a file does not by itself make a process GDPR or HIPAA compliant.
